description: This class is responsible for loading locale-specific message resource bundles for the web application from properties files on the classpath. It implements singleton pattern management, resource parsing, and locale handling for internationalization support in OpenMRS.

classes.name: CustomResourceLoader
classes.description: Manages loading message resource bundles for different locales from properties files, with singleton pattern implementation, locale parsing, and resource management functionalities.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CustomResourceLoader, creating it if it does not exist, optionally initializing with an HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: parseLocaleFrom
methods.description: Derives a Locale object from the filename of a resource properties file based on a naming convention.

methods.name: getResourceBundle
methods.description: Retrieves the ResourceBundle associated with a specified Locale.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the map of Locales to ResourceBundles maintained by this loader.

methods.name: getAvailablelocales
methods.description: Returns the set of Locales currently supported, based on loaded resource files.
